sql.query: WITH RECURSIVE acct_tree AS ( SELECT n.node_id, n.parent_id FROM ad_treenode n WHERE n.ad_tree_id = COALESCE( (SELECT e.ad_tree_id FROM c_acctschema_element ase JOIN c_element e ON e.c_element_id = ase.c_element_id WHERE ase.c_acctschema_id = '__ACCTSCHEMAID__' AND ase.elementtype = 'AC' LIMIT 1), (SELECT t.ad_tree_id FROM ad_tree t WHERE t.treetype = 'EV' AND t.isactive = 'Y' AND t.ad_client_id IN ('__CLIENT_ID__') LIMIT 1)) ), base AS ( SELECT fa.account_id, bp.c_bpartner_id AS bpartner_id, bp.name AS bpname, p.m_product_id AS product_id, p.name AS productname, pj.c_project_id AS project_id, pj.name AS projectname, cc.c_costcenter_id AS costcenter_id, cc.name AS costcentername, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fa.dateacct < '__DATEFROM__'::date OR (fa.dateacct = '__DATEFROM__'::date AND fa.factaccttype = 'O' AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true') THEN fa.amtacctdr - fa.amtacctcr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS opening_balance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fa.dateacct >= '__DATEFROM__'::date AND fa.dateacct <= '__DATETO__'::date AND NOT (fa.dateacct = '__DATEFROM__'::date AND fa.factaccttype = 'O' AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true') THEN fa.amtacctdr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activity_debit, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fa.dateacct >= '__DATEFROM__'::date AND fa.dateacct <= '__DATETO__'::date AND NOT (fa.dateacct = '__DATEFROM__'::date AND fa.factaccttype = 'O' AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true') THEN fa.amtacctcr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activity_credit, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fa.dateacct <= '__DATETO__'::date THEN fa.amtacctdr - fa.amtacctcr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closing_balance FROM fact_acct fa JOIN c_elementvalue lev ON lev.c_elementvalue_id = fa.account_id LEFT JOIN c_bpartner bp ON bp.c_bpartner_id = fa.c_bpartner_id LEFT JOIN m_product p ON p.m_product_id = fa.m_product_id LEFT JOIN c_project pj ON pj.c_project_id = fa.c_project_id LEFT JOIN c_costcenter cc ON cc.c_costcenter_id = fa.c_costcenter_id WHERE fa.ad_client_id IN ('__CLIENT_ID__') AND fa.factaccttype NOT IN ('R', 'C') AND fa.dateacct <= '__DATETO__'::date AND ('__ORGID__' = '' OR fa.ad_org_id = '__ORGID__') AND ('__ACCTSCHEMAID__' = '' OR fa.c_acctschema_id = '__ACCTSCHEMAID__') AND ('__BPARTNERID__' = '' OR fa.c_bpartner_id = '__BPARTNERID__') AND ('__PRODUCTID__' = '' OR fa.m_product_id = '__PRODUCTID__') AND ('__PROJECTID__' = '' OR fa.c_project_id = '__PROJECTID__') AND ('__COSTCENTERID__' = '' OR fa.c_costcenter_id = '__COSTCENTERID__') AND ('__FROMACCOUNTID__' = '' OR lev.value >= '__FROMACCOUNTID__') AND ('__TOACCOUNTID__' = '' OR lev.value <= '__TOACCOUNTID__') GROUP BY fa.account_id, bp.c_bpartner_id, bp.name, p.m_product_id, p.name, pj.c_project_id, pj.name, cc.c_costcenter_id, cc.name ), acct_anc AS ( SELECT DISTINCT b.account_id AS leaf_id, b.account_id AS anc_id FROM base b UNION SELECT a.leaf_id, t.parent_id FROM acct_anc a JOIN acct_tree t ON t.node_id = a.anc_id WHERE t.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND t.parent_id <> '0' ), elem_up AS ( SELECT t.node_id AS start_id, t.parent_id AS anc_id FROM acct_tree t WHERE t.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND t.parent_id <> '0' UNION SELECT e.start_id, t.parent_id FROM elem_up e JOIN acct_tree t ON t.node_id = e.anc_id WHERE t.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND t.parent_id <> '0' ) SELECT ev.value AS account_no, ev.c_elementvalue_id AS account_id, ev.name AS account_name, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM elem_up eu JOIN c_elementvalue anc_ev ON anc_ev.c_elementvalue_id = eu.anc_id WHERE eu.start_id = ev.c_elementvalue_id AND anc_ev.elementlevel = '__ACCOUNTLEVEL__') AS is_root, b.bpartner_id, b.bpname, b.product_id, b.productname, b.project_id, b.projectname, b.costcenter_id, b.costcentername, SUM(b.opening_balance) AS opening_balance, SUM(b.activity_debit) AS activity_debit, SUM(b.activity_credit) AS activity_credit, SUM(b.closing_balance) AS closing_balance FROM base b JOIN acct_anc a ON a.leaf_id = b.account_id JOIN c_elementvalue ev ON ev.c_elementvalue_id = a.anc_id WHERE ev.elementlevel = '__ACCOUNTLEVEL__' GROUP BY ev.value, ev.c_elementvalue_id, ev.name, is_root, b.bpartner_id, b.bpname, b.product_id, b.productname, b.project_id, b.projectname, b.costcenter_id, b.costcentername ORDER BY ev.value
sql.treeQuery: WITH RECURSIVE acct_tree AS ( SELECT n.node_id, n.parent_id FROM ad_treenode n WHERE n.ad_tree_id = COALESCE( (SELECT e.ad_tree_id FROM c_acctschema_element ase JOIN c_element e ON e.c_element_id = ase.c_element_id WHERE ase.c_acctschema_id = '__ACCTSCHEMAID__' AND ase.elementtype = 'AC' LIMIT 1), (SELECT t.ad_tree_id FROM ad_tree t WHERE t.treetype = 'EV' AND t.isactive = 'Y' AND t.ad_client_id IN ('__CLIENT_ID__') LIMIT 1)) ), base AS ( SELECT fa.account_id, CASE WHEN '__GROUPBY__' IN ('bpartner', 'product', 'project', 'costcenter') THEN COALESCE(CASE '__GROUPBY__' WHEN 'bpartner' THEN fa.c_bpartner_id WHEN 'product' THEN fa.m_product_id WHEN 'project' THEN fa.c_project_id WHEN 'costcenter' THEN fa.c_costcenter_id END, '') END AS dim_id, COALESCE(SUM(fa.amtacctdr - fa.amtacctcr) FILTER (WHERE fa.dateacct < '__DATEFROM__'::date OR (fa.dateacct = '__DATEFROM__'::date AND fa.factaccttype = 'O' AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true')), 0) AS opening_balance, COALESCE(SUM(fa.amtacctdr) FILTER (WHERE fa.dateacct >= '__DATEFROM__'::date AND NOT (fa.dateacct = '__DATEFROM__'::date AND fa.factaccttype = 'O' AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true')), 0) AS activity_debit, COALESCE(SUM(fa.amtacctcr) FILTER (WHERE fa.dateacct >= '__DATEFROM__'::date AND NOT (fa.dateacct = '__DATEFROM__'::date AND fa.factaccttype = 'O' AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true')), 0) AS activity_credit, COALESCE(SUM(fa.amtacctdr - fa.amtacctcr), 0) AS closing_balance FROM fact_acct fa JOIN c_elementvalue lev ON lev.c_elementvalue_id = fa.account_id WHERE fa.ad_client_id IN ('__CLIENT_ID__') AND fa.factaccttype NOT IN ('R', 'C') AND fa.dateacct <= '__DATETO__'::date AND ('__ORGID__' = '' OR fa.ad_org_id IN (SELECT o.ad_org_id FROM ad_org o WHERE o.ad_client_id IN ('__CLIENT_ID__', '0') AND ad_isorgincluded(o.ad_org_id, '__ORGID__', '__CLIENT_ID__') <> -1)) AND ('__ACCTSCHEMAID__' = '' OR fa.c_acctschema_id = '__ACCTSCHEMAID__') AND ('__BPARTNERID__' = '' OR fa.c_bpartner_id = '__BPARTNERID__') AND ('__PRODUCTID__' = '' OR fa.m_product_id = '__PRODUCTID__') AND ('__PROJECTID__' = '' OR fa.c_project_id = '__PROJECTID__') AND ('__COSTCENTERID__' = '' OR fa.c_costcenter_id = '__COSTCENTERID__') AND ('__FROMACCOUNTID__' = '' OR lev.value >= '__FROMACCOUNTID__') AND ('__TOACCOUNTID__' = '' OR lev.value <= '__TOACCOUNTID__') GROUP BY 1, 2 ), own AS ( SELECT b.account_id, SUM(b.opening_balance) AS opening_balance, SUM(b.activity_debit) AS activity_debit, SUM(b.activity_credit) AS activity_credit, SUM(b.closing_balance) AS closing_balance FROM base b GROUP BY b.account_id ), acct_anc AS ( SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id AS leaf_id, o.account_id AS anc_id FROM own o UNION SELECT a.leaf_id, t.parent_id FROM acct_anc a JOIN acct_tree t ON t.node_id = a.anc_id WHERE t.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND t.parent_id <> '0' ) SELECT ev.c_elementvalue_id AS node_id, tn.parent_id AS parent_id, ev.value AS value, ev.name AS name, ev.elementlevel AS elementlevel, ev.value AS sort_path, ev.c_elementvalue_id AS account_id, NULL::varchar AS dimension_id, NULL::varchar AS dimension_name, COALESCE(o.opening_balance, 0) AS opening_balance, COALESCE(o.activity_debit, 0) AS activity_debit, COALESCE(o.activity_credit, 0) AS activity_credit, COALESCE(o.closing_balance, 0) AS closing_balance FROM (SELECT DISTINCT anc_id FROM acct_anc) n JOIN c_elementvalue ev ON ev.c_elementvalue_id = n.anc_id LEFT JOIN acct_tree tn ON tn.node_id = ev.c_elementvalue_id LEFT JOIN own o ON o.account_id = ev.c_elementvalue_id UNION ALL SELECT b.account_id AS node_id, NULL::varchar AS parent_id, ev.value AS value, ev.name AS name, ev.elementlevel AS elementlevel, ev.value AS sort_path, b.account_id AS account_id, b.dim_id::varchar AS dimension_id, COALESCE(CASE '__GROUPBY__' WHEN 'bpartner' THEN (SELECT bp.name FROM c_bpartner bp WHERE bp.c_bpartner_id = b.dim_id) WHEN 'product' THEN (SELECT p.name FROM m_product p WHERE p.m_product_id = b.dim_id) WHEN 'project' THEN (SELECT pj.name FROM c_project pj WHERE pj.c_project_id = b.dim_id) WHEN 'costcenter' THEN (SELECT cc.name FROM c_costcenter cc WHERE cc.c_costcenter_id = b.dim_id) END, '')::varchar AS dimension_name, b.opening_balance, b.activity_debit, b.activity_credit, b.closing_balance FROM base b JOIN c_elementvalue ev ON ev.c_elementvalue_id = b.account_id WHERE b.dim_id IS NOT NULL
sql.periodQuery: WITH buckets(idx, f, t, sf, st, pf, pt) AS (VALUES __PERIODS__), days AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT fa.account_id, CASE WHEN '__GROUPBY__' IN ('bpartner', 'product', 'project', 'costcenter') THEN COALESCE(CASE '__GROUPBY__' WHEN 'bpartner' THEN fa.c_bpartner_id WHEN 'product' THEN fa.m_product_id WHEN 'project' THEN fa.c_project_id WHEN 'costcenter' THEN fa.c_costcenter_id END, '') END AS dim_id, fa.dateacct, (fa.factaccttype = 'O') AS is_o, SUM(fa.amtacctdr) AS dr, SUM(fa.amtacctcr) AS cr FROM fact_acct fa JOIN c_elementvalue lev ON lev.c_elementvalue_id = fa.account_id WHERE fa.ad_client_id IN ('__CLIENT_ID__') AND fa.factaccttype NOT IN ('R', 'C') AND fa.dateacct <= '__DATETO__'::date AND ('__ORGID__' = '' OR fa.ad_org_id IN (SELECT o.ad_org_id FROM ad_org o WHERE o.ad_client_id IN ('__CLIENT_ID__', '0') AND ad_isorgincluded(o.ad_org_id, '__ORGID__', '__CLIENT_ID__') <> -1)) AND ('__ACCTSCHEMAID__' = '' OR fa.c_acctschema_id = '__ACCTSCHEMAID__') AND ('__BPARTNERID__' = '' OR fa.c_bpartner_id = '__BPARTNERID__') AND ('__PRODUCTID__' = '' OR fa.m_product_id = '__PRODUCTID__') AND ('__PROJECTID__' = '' OR fa.c_project_id = '__PROJECTID__') AND ('__COSTCENTERID__' = '' OR fa.c_costcenter_id = '__COSTCENTERID__') AND ('__FROMACCOUNTID__' = '' OR lev.value >= '__FROMACCOUNTID__') AND ('__TOACCOUNTID__' = '' OR lev.value <= '__TOACCOUNTID__') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ), facts AS ( SELECT d.account_id, d.dim_id, b.idx, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dateacct < b.f OR (d.dateacct = b.f AND d.is_o AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true') THEN d.dr - d.cr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS opening_balance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dateacct BETWEEN b.f AND b.t AND NOT (d.dateacct = b.f AND d.is_o AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true') THEN d.dr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activity_debit, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dateacct BETWEEN b.f AND b.t AND NOT (d.dateacct = b.f AND d.is_o AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true') THEN d.cr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activity_credit, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dateacct <= b.t THEN d.dr - d.cr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closing_balance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dateacct < b.sf OR (d.dateacct = b.sf AND d.is_o AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true') THEN d.dr - d.cr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS opening_balance_sly, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dateacct BETWEEN b.sf AND b.st AND NOT (d.dateacct = b.sf AND d.is_o AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true') THEN d.dr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activity_debit_sly, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dateacct BETWEEN b.sf AND b.st AND NOT (d.dateacct = b.sf AND d.is_o AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true') THEN d.cr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activity_credit_sly, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dateacct <= b.st THEN d.dr - d.cr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closing_balance_sly, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dateacct < b.pf OR (d.dateacct = b.pf AND d.is_o AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true') THEN d.dr - d.cr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS opening_balance_prev, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dateacct BETWEEN b.pf AND b.pt AND NOT (d.dateacct = b.pf AND d.is_o AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true') THEN d.dr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activity_debit_prev, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dateacct BETWEEN b.pf AND b.pt AND NOT (d.dateacct = b.pf AND d.is_o AND '__OPENINGENTRYAMOUNT__' = 'true') THEN d.cr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activity_credit_prev, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.dateacct <= b.pt THEN d.dr - d.cr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closing_balance_prev FROM days d JOIN buckets b ON d.dateacct <= GREATEST(b.t, b.st, b.pt) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ) SELECT f.idx, f.account_id, f.dim_id::varchar AS dimension_id, COALESCE(CASE '__GROUPBY__' WHEN 'bpartner' THEN (SELECT bp.name FROM c_bpartner bp WHERE bp.c_bpartner_id = f.dim_id) WHEN 'product' THEN (SELECT p.name FROM m_product p WHERE p.m_product_id = f.dim_id) WHEN 'project' THEN (SELECT pj.name FROM c_project pj WHERE pj.c_project_id = f.dim_id) WHEN 'costcenter' THEN (SELECT cc.name FROM c_costcenter cc WHERE cc.c_costcenter_id = f.dim_id) END, '')::varchar AS dimension_name, f.opening_balance, f.activity_debit, f.activity_credit, f.closing_balance, f.opening_balance_sly, f.activity_debit_sly, f.activity_credit_sly, f.closing_balance_sly, f.opening_balance_prev, f.activity_debit_prev, f.activity_credit_prev, f.closing_balance_prev FROM facts f WHERE f.opening_balance <> 0 OR f.activity_debit <> 0 OR f.activity_credit <> 0 OR f.closing_balance <> 0 OR f.opening_balance_sly <> 0 OR f.activity_debit_sly <> 0 OR f.activity_credit_sly <> 0 OR f.closing_balance_sly <> 0 OR f.opening_balance_prev <> 0 OR f.activity_debit_prev <> 0 OR f.activity_credit_prev <> 0 OR f.closing_balance_prev <> 0
